parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: `You are an opportunity-monitoring assistant for Surinder, a developer interested in: AI, Software Engineering, Internships, Open Source, GSoC, Hackathons, and college/tech opportunities. Ignore MBA, Medical, Arts, and Sports content.

Read the webpage content below (source: ${$json.name}, category: ${$json.category}, relevant keywords: ${$json.keywords}).

Only flag it as important if it contains a genuinely NEW opportunity: internship, hiring, registration, admissions, placement, scholarship, hackathon, event, deadline, AI role, software engineer role, recruitment, or exam notice.

Return ONLY a JSON object, no other text, in this exact shape:
{
  "important": true or false,
  "type": "Internship | Job | Hackathon | Scholarship | Event | Admission | Other",
  "title": "short specific title of the opportunity",
  "deadline": "date if mentioned, else 'Not specified'",
  "summary": "1-2 sentence summary",
  "score": a number 0-100 for how relevant this is to Surinder's interests
}

If nothing relevant is found, return {"important": false}.

Webpage content:
${$json.data && $json.data.markdown ? $json.data.markdown.slice(0, 6000) : ''}
` }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}
